Units.Description: Cheapest single body; quick deployment lets it buy a moment for another recruit.
Units.Weakness: Very low damage and protection; cannot hold a durable enemy alone.

Units.Description: One payment deploys two bodies, offering a broader early blocking line.
Units.Weakness: Splash punishes the pair; each body is fragile.

Units.Description: Cheap reach behind another melee body; its committed thrust answers physical armor.
Units.Weakness: Poor close defense when a flanker reaches it.

Units.Description: Affordable ordinary ranged support with a limited volley.
Units.Weakness: Needs protection and contributes no ordinary structure damage.

Units.Description: Reliable mobile generalist with a modest cleave.
Units.Weakness: No specialist answer to heavy armor, wards, or ranged focus.

Units.Description: Channels repeated healing into one injured patient.
Units.Weakness: Interrupted healing stops; requires an intact frontline.

Units.Description: Committed chops do extra damage to temporary shields and breakable tactical blockers.
Units.Weakness: Short reach; the bonus does not bypass permanent armor or create a structure-damage premium.

Units.Description: Every third committed hit briefly reduces one enemy armor rating for allied follow-up.
Units.Weakness: Slow windup; must survive repeated contact.

Units.Description: Repairs the wagon and maintains one temporary repairable bolt emplacement.
Units.Weakness: Low personal damage and a vulnerable setup; construction support is its main job.

Units.Description: A marked hook attack pulls an eligible ordinary enemy a short distance into the line.
Units.Weakness: Cannot drag bosses or anchored targets; recovery exposes it to nearby attackers.

Units.Description: Alternates ordinary strikes with a short personal physical guard window.
Units.Weakness: Moderate cost and damage; its guard does not protect allies or stop magical damage.

Units.Description: Deliberate precision shots and a special aimed at a distant priority target.
Units.Weakness: Lower movement and firing cadence than light melee.

Units.Description: Holds contact and periodically intercepts an eligible projectile aimed at a nearby ally.
Units.Weakness: Limited interception allowance; vulnerable to magical damage and field hazards.

Units.Description: Maintains its combat aura and periodic area healing.
Units.Weakness: Lower patient healing than the Medic; dispersed allies miss the aura.

Units.Description: Protecting a wounded ally charges a radiant melee strike and a limited allied shield.
Units.Weakness: High cost; needs a nearby patient and has a long support cooldown.

Units.Description: Braces against a telegraphed charge and interrupts the first eligible charger reaching the point.
Units.Weakness: Moving or displacement cancels the brace; flankers can close inside its reach.

Units.Description: Combines reach with a committed frontal sweep against clustered troops.
Units.Weakness: Sweep recovery creates a punish window; ordinary stronghold damage replaces its siege premium.

Units.Description: Makes an offensive line charge, then commits to close combat.
Units.Weakness: A braced defender stops the charge; expensive losses.

Units.Description: Returns once at 25% of maximum HP and permanently reduced speed; the return is part of its survivability budget.
Units.Weakness: Corpse denial prevents return; revival sources share one return allowance.

Units.Description: A long frontal cut reaches up to three closely aligned ordinary targets.
Units.Weakness: Slow committed swing and little rear protection; this is a game specialization inspired by late medieval two-handed swords.

Units.Description: Qualifying nearby allied kills produce small manually collected courage packs on a shared cooldown.
Units.Weakness: Low direct damage; no rewards from summoned or artificial targets.

Units.Description: Missing health increases its offensive pressure and frenzy accelerates real attack recovery.
Units.Weakness: Low protection; burst or ranged focus can kill it before its pressure pays off.

Units.Description: A close-range setup plants demolition against a structure or explicitly fortified target.
Units.Weakness: Two vulnerable bodies, weak ordinary combat, interruptible setup.

Units.Description: Intercepts the first threat nearing the wagon, then fights as a fast light melee troop.
Units.Weakness: One interception; less sustained toughness than the offensive Cavalry Rider.

Units.Description: Charges a powerful straight shot while stationary.
Units.Weakness: Displacement loses the charge; poor close defense.

Units.Description: Every fourth committed heavy hit interrupts an eligible windup or channel with a short stagger.
Units.Weakness: Must stay in contact; control resistance prevents a permanent lock.

Units.Description: Targets an exposed backline and gains a real next-strike bonus after Vanish.
Units.Weakness: Fragile when revealed or caught by area attacks.

Units.Description: Parries one telegraphed melee strike and ripostes against that opponent.
Units.Weakness: A single-target defense; projectiles and multiple attackers overwhelm it.

Units.Description: Provides magical direct damage and a line-piercing Arcane Beam.
Units.Weakness: A small late support option; fragile and vulnerable to null fields.

Units.Description: Alternates a committed crushing blow and a thrust with personal physical-armor penetration.
Units.Weakness: High cost and slow recovery; penetration helps its own hit rather than exposing armor for the whole squad.

Units.Description: Fights at the front while rallying nearby allies offensively.
Units.Weakness: Needs a nearby formation and lacks Shield Knight projectile interception.

Units.Description: Sustained ranged structure pressure with an armor-piercing marked siege shot.
Units.Weakness: Slow deployment and recovery; vulnerable to close attackers.

Units.Description: A swift, inexpensive melee scout that reaches threats quickly.
A ranged alchemist whose thrown mixtures damage clustered enemies.
A support caster that raises temporary servants from fallen enemies.
A defensive melee guard that protects nearby allies.
A magical ranged specialist that strikes clustered enemies.
A slow foot soldier that advances straight toward the wagon.
Units.Weakness: Affordable melee troops can hold it while ranged allies attack.

Units.Description: A fast, fragile attacker that rushes gaps in the frontline.
Units.Weakness: Keep a cheap melee blocker ready rather than relying on ranged troops alone.

Units.Description: A swollen undead attacker that bursts when defeated, damaging nearby allies.
Units.Weakness: Use ranged attacks or spread your melee bodies before the killing blow.

Units.Description: A durable melee fighter that trades speed for heavy close-range blows.
Units.Weakness: Hold it with a blocker while ranged allies wear it down.

Units.Description: An ordinary ranged enemy that attacks from behind its frontline.
Units.Weakness: Break through its escorts or use a spell to reach the backline.

Units.Description: Splits into two smaller enemies when defeated.
Units.Weakness: Save courage for a second blocker and use a cleave against the small bodies.

Units.Description: A swift raider that prioritizes reaching and damaging the wagon.
Units.Weakness: Intercept it early with an affordable melee unit.

Units.Description: Rallies nearby enemies, increasing their damage and movement speed.
Units.Weakness: Defeat the Herald before its escorts gather around it.

Units.Description: Disrupts the wagon signal, briefly delaying troop deployment.
Units.Weakness: Keep an existing melee line alive and deploy again when the disruption ends.

Units.Description: An armored tank that absorbs ordinary physical attacks.
Units.Weakness: Use armor-breaking attacks or magical damage while keeping a blocker in front.

Units.Description: Intercepts projectiles to protect nearby enemies.
Units.Weakness: Engage the formation with melee troops and attack its exposed support.

Units.Description: Periodically calls undead reinforcements into the fight.
Units.Weakness: Focus the Lich before repeated summons overwhelm your frontline.

Units.Description: A slow reinforcement carrier that delivers enemies near the wagon.
Units.Weakness: Destroy it before it reaches your defenses.

Units.Description: Reflects part of direct damage back to its attacker.
Units.Weakness: Support attackers with healing and avoid committing a fragile ally alone.

Units.Description: Burrows behind the rearmost troop to threaten the backline.
Units.Weakness: Keep a spare melee troop ready to protect ranged and support allies.

Units.Description: Long-range artillery that can strike the wagon.
Units.Weakness: Advance melee pressure or use a spell to interrupt the artillery line.

Units.Description: A giant whose sweeping melee attacks hit nearby troops; three smaller enemies emerge when it falls.
Units.Weakness: Spread the frontline and reserve a cleave or spell for its smaller bodies.

Units.Description: An undead commander that rallies its escorts.
Units.Weakness: Defeat the Captain while holding its escorts away from your support.

Units.Description: Heavy artillery that threatens the wagon from behind enemy escorts.
Units.Weakness: Push through the escorts and keep the wagon repaired while closing the distance.

Units.Description: Rallies nearby enemies and calls escorts while leading the assault.
Units.Weakness: Protect a melee line, support wounded troops, and interrupt marked casts when possible. Bosses recover quickly from control.

Units.Description: Small packs slip around a single isolated blocker.
Units.Weakness: Use a cheap screen or area damage.

Units.Description: Weak attacks but frontal physical armor; rear or armor-breaking hits expose it.
Units.Weakness: Maceman, magic, or surround with several bodies.

Units.Description: Channels a visible bell call that recruits a small pack; interrupting it prevents the call.
Units.Weakness: Ranged focus or an interrupt.

Units.Description: A living bandit shoots once, retreats, and then draws a knife.
Units.Weakness: Cheap fast melee; pin it before it retreats.

Units.Description: Telegraphs a harpoon that pulls the foremost allied unit out of formation.
Units.Weakness: Interrupt, barrier, or displacement protection.

Units.Description: Briefly phases through a blocker; becomes vulnerable before attacking.
Units.Weakness: Keep a second defender near ranged troops.

Units.Description: A shell plate absorbs a limited number of direct hits before breaking.
Units.Weakness: Fast hits, armor break, or a timed heavy follow-up.

Units.Description: Runs past a moving frontline to attack a nearby support troop; ordinary blockers still stop it.
Units.Weakness: A held reserve defender or crowd control.

Units.Description: Pauses with a bright coal glow before one rapid charge.
Units.Weakness: Pikeman, barrier, or a shot during the windup.

Units.Description: Its arcing shot leaves a short burning patch instead of persistent unavoidable damage.
Units.Weakness: Spread troops, cleanse burn, or kill the caster.

Units.Description: Armor hardens while glowing; cools after its heavy swing.
Units.Weakness: Burst during cooling or interrupt the windup.

Units.Description: Plants a visible powder keg, then retreats; the keg detonates after a delay.
Units.Weakness: Destroy the keg from range or move the fight.

Units.Description: Clings to an enemy tank and grants it limited healing; detaches when the host dies.
Units.Weakness: Area damage or kill the exposed leech during attachment.

Units.Description: Creates a marked cloud that reduces healing and applies capped blight.
Units.Weakness: Plague Doctor, Purifying Censer, or immediate caster focus.

Units.Description: Stops to heal one damaged enemy instead of attacking.
Units.Weakness: Interrupt or isolate the healer from its patient.

Units.Description: Channels a lance that strips one temporary ward or shield.
Units.Weakness: Interrupt, attack from another direction, or use raw health.

Units.Description: Crouches before leaping onto a ranged-primary unit.
Units.Weakness: Reserve melee or a trap near the backline.

Units.Description: Reflects melee contact damage while thorns are raised; drops them after swinging.
Units.Weakness: Ranged damage or attack during its exposed recovery.

Units.Description: Telegraphs a root around one allied troop; damage and cleansing break it early.
Units.Weakness: Ranged focus or cleanse; controls cannot chain indefinitely.

Units.Description: Throws a slow stone toward a marked cluster, briefly separating survivors.
Units.Weakness: Interrupt its lift or deploy away from the mark.

Units.Description: Tethers one frontline ally, limiting how far it can advance until the chain breaks.
Units.Weakness: Damage the penitent or sever the tether with a ward-breaking effect.

Units.Description: Its slow spine arrow penetrates the first unit and hurts the next.
Units.Weakness: Spread supports; a shield interceptor absorbs the arrow.

Units.Description: Consumes nearby enemy corpse tokens to raise one tougher servant after a chant.
Units.Weakness: Interrupt or deny the corpses.

Units.Description: A stationary warded eye opens after releasing a bolt, creating a brief attack window.
Units.Weakness: Timed damage or Wardbreaker; never requires a single specific unit.

Units.Description: A visible mound waits before erupting beneath an advancing troop.
Units.Weakness: A disposable scout or ranged hit on the mound.

Units.Description: Bursts into a short blight cloud that also harms nearby enemies.
Units.Weakness: Kill from range; exploit its position in the enemy pack.

Units.Description: Regenerates slowly inside its own marked water patch; lurches out to attack.
Units.Weakness: Force it out, deny healing, or burst after the lurch.

Units.Description: Makes one sharp dodge of an incoming projectile before committing to melee.
Units.Weakness: Fast second shot, splash, or a melee screen.

Units.Description: Winds up a long straight charge that ends on the first solid blocker.
Units.Weakness: Pikeman, Stone Barricade, or interrupt during the windup.

Units.Description: Alternates a short javelin volley with a vulnerable reload before retreating once.
Units.Weakness: Advance during reload or pin it with a root.

Units.Description: Consumes a limited number of enemy corpses to empower its nearby escorts.
Units.Weakness: Kill the bearer or remove corpse tokens.

Units.Description: Channels a drumbeat that advances nearby enemies' attack recovery.
Units.Weakness: Interrupt the beat or separate the drummer from its pack.

Units.Description: Fades during approach, then becomes targetable before its first strike.
Units.Weakness: Revealing light, traps, or a held rear guard.

Units.Description: Creates one damage-free copy that can draw target locks until hit.
Units.Weakness: Splash or revealing light; the real wisp has a distinct core.

Units.Description: Resists physical attacks while its wicker shell is intact; burn weakens the shell.
Units.Weakness: Fireball, Flame Adept, or Firepot Thrower.

Units.Description: Marks one support troop for sleep; any damage wakes it, and repeated sleep is resisted.
Units.Weakness: Cleanse, interrupt, or a decoy that draws the cast.

Units.Description: Stops to smash a player blocker, causing a small blast behind it; weak against troops away from structures.
Units.Weakness: Intercept in open ground or damage it during the windup.

Units.Description: A marked heavy swing wounds one target, briefly reducing healing received.
Units.Weakness: Parry, interrupt, or cleanse the wound.

Units.Description: Places a visible null field that suppresses magical ward and spell effects locally.
Units.Weakness: Physical attackers, interrupt, or cast outside the field.

Units.Description: Stores one elite enemy's soul and returns it once unless the standard is destroyed.
Units.Weakness: Kill the standard first or deny the marked corpse.

Units.Description: A rare non-attacking traveler offers a visible salvage cache after a brief protected passage.
Units.Weakness: Optional escort decision; no penalty for ignoring it and no reward for killing it.
